0.question: Police Department. We received a call from this apartment.

1.question: That's strange. The call came from this address. May I come inside?

2.question: I'm here to make sure everything is alright. May I come in?

3.question: Did anyone visit you earlier tonight?

5.question: No one at all? Think carefully, boy...

6.question: Did he tell you not to open the door tonight?

7.question: Because... he always says the same thing.

8.question: Hahaha, can I come in, dear?

9.question: Tell me... did you really call the police?

10.question: No... you're very lame, boy. (The officer smiles.)

11.question: So why don't you open the door? (The officer's smile stretches just a little too wide as he tries to break in.)

12.question: You shouldn't trust every familiar face.
